the independent review classified the impact on the architecture as major: The change adds owner-provided risk inputs to shared risk classification and propagates them through agent selection, review requirements, records, and the merge gate. It also adds start-feature.sh and run-feature.sh command-line options and stores Issue-label risk in branch Git configuration. This changes shared workflow infrastructure and its public interface. The architecture document is still a template and no accepted ADR was present to compare against.
explanation: Issue #227: Let the owner raise the risk level of a feature before its first session, by an Issue label or --risk. The merge of this feature needs the owner's approval for the reasons listed; the approval is the owner's review of the pull request on GitHub, bound to the commit by GitHub. This request asks and records; it grants nothing.
